result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: the bottom navigation overlaps feed content, and horizontally scrolling rows expose abruptly clipped items at the right edge.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlays the next restaurant card; the pizza image and its card are visibly cut off beneath the navigation instead of ending above it.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding/inset for the fixed navigation bar so feed cards remain fully visible and scroll above it.

issues.description: The category row and the 'Fastest near you' carousel show partially cut-off pills/cards at the right edge, including a mostly empty-looking category pill and truncated restaurant content.
issues.suggestion: Use intentional carousel edge treatment (such as a fade/peek indicator) and ensure clipped items retain enough visible context, or align the final visible item cleanly within the viewport.
